name: National Assembly
notes: 400 seats; who sits and their party are from the Parliamentary Monitoring Group's member list (the National Assembly members flagged as current). The Government of National Unity parties are the ANC, DA, IFP, PA, GOOD and others.

name: National Council of Provinces
notes: 90 seats: ten for each province (six permanent delegates and four special delegates). The Parliamentary Monitoring Group's member list names the 54 permanent delegates; the 36 special delegates, who change with the provinces' business, are not listed and show as 'Special delegates (not listed)'. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
